summary: A Yes vote enacts a 3/8% sales tax for 30 years, estimated at $13 million annually, for emergency services and wildfire prevention.

tax.text: The Yes on Measure S position supports enacting a 3/8% sales tax for 30 years to fund hospitals, fire protection, wildfire prevention, and emergency response.
tax.quote: shall the measure enacting a 3/8% sales tax for 30 years in El Dorado County, providing approximately $13,000,000 annually
